Workflow.Name: DealOS | WhatsApp chat import
Workflow.Description: A WhatsApp Export conversation gets its source document (the exported .txt or .zip) → gc_ImportWhatsAppChat in batches until done → audit. Media are stored Quarantined; voice notes go to Voice note transcription.
